THE DISCOVERY, and it is the transferable part. MWCC emits a flat commutative `|` chain in SOURCE TERM ORDER: the first two terms feed the first `or`, and each later term arrives as the first source operand of `or rD, rNewTerm, rAcc`. That makes the target's chain a direct READ-OUT of the original source's term order. Decoding it here (bit masks recovered from each `rlwinm rX,rY,0,n,n` site, then matched to chain position) showed the original wrote `eB | eA | eC | eD | e[0] | e[1] | ... | e[23]` where we had written the exact reverse. This single reordering was worth +2.64 fuzzy points and 13 multiset tokens. Recorded as claim.law.IH_commutative-chain-emission-order-reads-back-source-term-order.20260901.v1.

WHY THE WORK ORDER'S FRAMING WAS INCOMPLETE, measured rather than argued: the brief asked which ~5 of 24 edge values are memory-resident. Decoding the chain shows target holds SEVEN values in memory (eB@56, eA@60, eC@64, eD@68, e0@44, e2@116, e3@112) and 21 in registers, and OUR build already holds seven (eB, eA, eC, eD, e0, e1, e2). The residency sets differ by ONE member (target keeps e3 in memory and e1 in r11; we keep e1 and not e3). The residency question was therefore never the gap it was framed as -- the ORDER was.

REMAINING RESIDUAL, one named mechanism: FRAME OVERSHOOT. slotdiff reads target 192 / ours 248, target 26 slots / ours 19, 24T/17O exclusive. Every one of the 24 target-only slots is a compiler temp we do not generate (the `old & bit` temporaries at 72/76/80/84 at the last four BTN_EDGE sites, the accumulator round-trips at 88/92/96/100 in the chain head, the split `hit` webs at 48/52) or an e-value we hold in a register. The 56-byte excess is DEAD nominal area from `u32 e[24]`, of which only two members are memory-resident. Downstream of it sit the whole remaining multiset (target-only +2 clrlwi +2 cmplwi +4 cmpwi +7 lwz +1 mr +5 rlwinm +1 slwi +9 stw against ours-only -1 addi -1 beq -2 clrlwi. -3 li -5 rlwinm.): target's memory-resident values must be computed non-record and re-tested with cmpwi/cmplwi, ours fuse into the `rlwinm.` dot form.

NEXT AGENT: do NOT re-probe all-scalar (measured twice, both orders, 88t), whole-array pointer access (prior record, real 1061), index renumbering (byte-identical), or ARRAY SHRINKING (measured this pass: e[20]+4 scalars gives real 931 and frame 224 -- better on both -- yet fuzzy 83.94 against 86.47, because the four converted members immediately storm with +5 addi +3 mr). The array-size axis is closed in both directions. The untried shape is a source form that generates target's compiler temps rather than declaring storage -- i.e. raising register pressure at the chain head, not adding locals.
